tools.name: listRegistryItems
tools.description: Lists Magic UI registry items with optional filtering by kind, query, and limit.

kind.description: Optional kind filter such as component, example, style, or a raw registry type like registry:ui.

query.description: Optional text filter applied to names, titles, descriptions, and registry types.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Pagination offset for exhaustive registry browsing. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: getRegistryItem
tools.description: Gets detailed information for a single Magic UI registry item.

name.description: Exact registry item name, for example marquee.

includeSource.description: Include the item's source code content.

includeExamples.description: Include related example code when the item is a component.

includeRelated.description: Include related registry items such as examples or dependencies.

tools.name: searchRegistryItems
tools.description: Searches Magic UI registry items by keyword or use case.

query.description: Search query matched against names, titles, descriptions, and registry types.

kind.description: Optional kind filter such as component, example, or style.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Pagination offset for stepping through ranked search results. Defaults to 0.
